title: Genie Agents enhancements
body:
* **Flash (Beta)**: Agent mode now offers Flash, an option that prioritizes response speed over depth. Flash is most efficient on simpler, everyday tasks. See [Flash](/aws/en/genie-agents/concepts#flash).
* **Agent mode model upgrade**: Agent mode now uses upgraded models that better handle long context and respond faster. See [Agent mode](/aws/en/genie-agents/concepts#agent-mode).
